xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #3198 portfolio prioritization pass (swarm add-on)

plan.title: feat(triage,meta): portfolio prioritization pass — priority briefs from local cache (propose-not-apply)

narratives.Description: Maintainers need pre-promotion portfolio prioritization: cluster competing RFCs/issues from the local github-issue cache, name conflicts/supersession, and emit a priority brief (shortlist + park list). This is propose-not-apply — no SCM label writes, no triage:accept, no xBRIEF lifecycle mutations. It sits between automated label-mirror triage (#1423) and post-promotion ranking (#1419/#1511) and triage:queue.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer facing a large open backlog, I want a portfolio prioritization pass that produces a verified shortlist and park list from local cache without mutating SCM, so that I can dispose decisions into the decision log instead of re-litigating markdown essays.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Add a scoped skill or playbook (content/skills or packs) with triggers, inputs (local cache + optional classify JSON), and propose-not-apply stance (#3179). 2. Output template: theme/label/title-family clusters, conflict/supersession matrix, shortlist, park list, dispose checklist pointing at #1396 decision log + plan-sequence. 3. Epistemic gates MUST: verify every cited issue exists (live gh or fresh cache), read body (+ comments when claiming decided/superseded), accurate open/closed; no title-only supersession. 4. Explicit non-goals: no label mirror writes; does not replace triage:queue; no unattended auto-promote. 5. Cross-link #886; CHANGELOG; optional thin CLI later if needed — skill-first is OK. 6. Tests or content-contract pins for key skill tokens if framework requires. Verify: skill present, docs coherent, task check. Dogfood pilot comment on #3198 may inform template.
narratives.Labels: enhancement, meta, triage, agent-experience, process, status:child
narratives.Overview: Parent #886. Related #1419/#1511 post-promotion sibling; #3179 propose-not-apply; #1423/#3197 A-side mirror.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a documented portfolio prioritization skill or playbook, when an agent follows it, then inputs (local github-issue cache + optional classify dry-run JSON) and propose-not-apply non-goals are explicit.
Given a pass completes, when the brief is written, then it includes clusters, conflict/supersession matrix, shortlist, park list, and dispose checklist toward #1396 + plan-sequence.
Given the skill, when claims cite issues, then agents MUST verify existence and read bodies (and comments when claiming decided/superseded); title-only supersession is forbidden.
Given the shipped path, when used, then it never writes SCM labels, never triage:accept, never scope lifecycle; CHANGELOG and #886 cross-links present.

swarm.missing_traces_justification: Skill-first story. May add content/skills/deft-directive-portfolio-prioritize/ or similar. Do not implement post-promotion #1419 buckets. Exclusive of label-mirror --re-enrich (#3197) and policy coverageDebt (#3189).
